releases.name: RakenOS 1.0.0
releases.title: Initial Release
releases.summary: RakenOS 1.0.0 is the first public release of RakenOS and establishes the foundation of the entire operating system: the Home Screen, Lock Screen, notifications, Control Center, Raken Store and the first version of the RakenOS Runtime.
highlights: Introduces RakenOS Home with a responsive app grid, a dock, widgets and fast access to every installed app.
The Home Screen layout automatically adapts spacing and the number of columns to the size of the display.
A new Lock Screen with clock, date, notifications, battery status and quick shortcuts.

sections.title: Home Screen
items: Introduces RakenOS Home with a responsive app grid, a dock, widgets and fast access to every installed app.
The Home Screen layout automatically adapts spacing and the number of columns to the size of the display.

sections.title: Lock Screen
items: A new Lock Screen with clock, date, notifications, battery status and quick shortcuts.
PIN protection with a numeric keypad, progressive lockout after repeated incorrect attempts and a separate emergency information view.

sections.title: Notifications
items: Introduces the RakenOS Notification Center with grouped notifications and individual actions.

sections.title: Control Center
items: Introduces quick controls for connectivity, brightness, volume, flashlight and Do Not Disturb.

sections.title: Camera
items: Introduces Camera with photo capture, a composition grid and automatic flash on supported hardware.

sections.title: Files
items: Introduces Files with Documents, Downloads and Pictures locations and basic file management.

sections.title: Raken Store
items: Introduces Raken Store with Discover, Search, Categories and a personal Library.
First-class support for RAS (Raken App Software) packages, including manifest validation and signature checks before installation.

sections.title: Settings
items: Introduces Settings with Display, Sound, Battery, Security, Privacy and System Update.

sections.title: System
items: First version of the RakenOS Runtime, including app lifecycle, navigation, system services and hardware capability detection.

sections.title: RAS Runtime
items: RAS API level 1 with sandboxed storage, notifications and clock services.

sections.title: RScript
items: Introduces RScript 1.0, the scripting language used by RAS applications.

releases.summary: RakenOS 59.0.2 is the latest release of RakenOS, focusing on polish, stability and security. It also brings improvements to Accessibility, Battery and System. This update also fixes 3 security issues. All users are encouraged to install it.
highlights: Updated trusted certificate authorities used by system services.
Improved reliability of long-running devices that are rarely restarted.

sections.title: Accessibility
items: Improved focus order when navigating the Security Guide with a keyboard.
Focus indicators are now visible on every Control Center tile.

sections.title: Security
items: Updated trusted certificate authorities used by system services.
A state management issue in the RScript interpreter could allow a crafted script to cause unexpected termination of the app worker. This was addressed with improved state management. (RKSA-59-021)
A logic issue in Private Space could allow Private Space app names to appear in Recent Apps. This was addressed with improved checks. (RKSA-59-022)
An integer overflow in the widget renderer could allow a widget to display content from another app. This was addressed with improved bounds checking. (RKSA-59-023)

sections.title: Battery
items: Background work related to update planning now pauses while Battery Saver is active.

sections.title: System
items: Improved reliability of long-running devices that are rarely restarted.
